headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Train Details Released
summary: Details regarding the route, schedule, and ticket fares for the new Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express have been released. The service aims to improve rail connectivity across the region.

headline: Scenic Vande Bharat Route Connects Bengaluru to Goa
summary: The new Vande Bharat train route running through the Western Ghats offers scenic views for travelers between Bengaluru and Goa. Passengers can experience lush landscapes and mountain views during the journey.

headline: PM Modi Launches Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has officially launched the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express. Regular train services on the route have now commenced.

headline: North Goa Notifies Watersports Zones and Safety Rules
summary: Authorities in North Goa have officially notified designated watersports zones. Mandatory safety regulations have been put in place for operators and tourists.

headline: FC Goa Parts Ways With Coach Gouramangi Singh
summary: FC Goa has officially separated from head coach Gouramangi Singh. The football club will be making changes to its coaching management.

headline: 27 Injured as Luxury Bus Overturns on Mumbai-Goa Highway
summary: A Mumbai-Goa luxury bus overturned after colliding with a truck, leaving 27 passengers injured. Emergency personnel rescued trapped passengers from the vehicle.

headline: Mumbai-Goa Vande Bharat Journey Goes Viral Online
summary: Footage highlighting the scenic bridges, tunnels, and green hills along the Mumbai-Goa Vande Bharat route has gone viral online. Travelers have widely shared videos of the visually striking rail journey.

headline: Coastal Defence Exercise Starts Along Goa Coast
summary: A coastal defence exercise has commenced along the Goa coastline to test security readiness. Defence personnel and security agencies are participating in the operation.

headline: Goa Prepares for IFFI 2026 With International Lineup
summary: Goa is preparing to host IFFI 2026 featuring 159 international films. Over 7,000 delegates are expected to attend the film festival.

headline: FC Goa Seeks Foreign Coach After Gouramangi Exit
summary: Following the departure of coach Gouramangi Singh, FC Goa is planning to hire a foreign coach. The team is reshaping its management staff.

headline: Pollution Control Board to Test Arla-Keri Lake Water
summary: The state pollution control body will collect and test water samples from Arla-Keri lake. The testing aims to assess water quality and contamination levels.

headline: Bihar Native Arrested for Child Assault in Goa
summary: A native of Bihar has been arrested in connection with the rape of a 4-year-old girl in Goa. This marks the second such reported incident within a week.

headline: Registrations Open for CM Trophy 2.0
summary: Registration has opened for CM Trophy 2.0, which will feature 12 different sports and cultural events. Competitors across the state can sign up to participate.

headline: 57th IFFI to Open With Film 'Fatherland'
summary: The 57th International Film Festival of India in Goa will open on November 20 with the screening of 'Fatherland'. The event marks the start of the annual festival.

headline: DMK MP Requests FCRA Bill Hearings in Goa and Bengaluru
summary: A DMK MP has urged a parliamentary committee to conduct hearings on the FCRA Bill in Goa and Bengaluru. The request seeks to allow broader consultations on the bill.

headline: Goa Police Block Hundreds of Fraudulent Websites
summary: Goa Police have blocked hundreds of fake websites as part of an interstate fraud operation. The crackdown targeted fraudulent online activities across state lines.

headline: Anjuna Residents Move Supreme Court to Protect Hill
summary: Locals in Anjuna have taken their fight against a hotel project on a 90,000 sq m hill to the Supreme Court. Residents are seeking to preserve the green landscape.

headline: Goa Eagles GC Wins X-Golf Tournament in Hyderabad
summary: Auro Realty Goa Eagles GC secured victory at the X-Golf competition held in Hyderabad. The team outperformed rivals to take top honors.

headline: Goa Congress Commemorates Nehru’s Birth Anniversary
summary: Goa Congress leaders paid tribute to Jawaharlal Nehru on his 137th birth anniversary. During the event, party leaders called for protecting democratic values.

headline: Contractor Duped of Rs 2 Crore in Casino Scheme
summary: A contractor was cheated of Rs 2 crore after being promised returns on a Goa casino investment. Police are investigating the investment fraud.

headline: Vlogger Reviews Food Menu on Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat
summary: A food vlogger documented the onboard meal options provided on the new Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express. The review highlights the menu items offered to passengers.

headline: Mulgao-Kasarpal Bypass Expansion Approved
summary: Plans have been set to expand the Mulgao-Kasarpal bypass road. The project aims to improve traffic movement and local infrastructure.

headline: Goa Explores Manufacturing Potential in Tech and Pharma
summary: Discussions are underway regarding Goa's potential to grow into a manufacturing hub for defence, pharmaceuticals, and green technology. Analysts are evaluating industrial growth opportunities.

headline: Ocean Safety Program Reaches 3,000 Participants
summary: An ocean safety initiative in Goa has drawn 3,000 participants over a 50-day period. The program focuses on promoting water safety awareness.

headline: Tribal Groups to Meet Over ST Quota Delay
summary: Tribal community leaders are holding a meeting in Sanguem to address delays in ST quota implementation. Attendees plan to decide on their next course of action.

headline: Goa Proposes Rail Shuttle to Mopa Airport
summary: The state government is considering a rail link connected to Mopa airport. The plan includes operating a fast shuttle service for commuters.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Route and Schedule Released
summary: Details regarding the stops, schedule, and route for the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat service have been announced. The train provides a faster transit option between the cities.

headline: 'Kantara' and 'The Kerala Story 2' Selected for IFFI Competition
summary: 'Kantara' and 'The Kerala Story 2' have been selected for the International Competition section at IFFI in Goa. The films will compete alongside global cinema entries.

headline: Major Titles Highlight International Lineup at IFFI
summary: Prominent films including 'Ramayana', 'Fatherland', and 'Dhurandhar' lead the upcoming IFFI lineup. Masterpieces by renowned international directors will also be featured.

headline: Dates and Highlights Announced for IFFI 2026
summary: Key details including dates, themes, and film lineups for IFFI 2026 have been announced. The event will bring global film showcases to Goa.

headline: Goa Delegation Visits Chandigarh College for Academic Exchange
summary: A delegation from Goa participated in an academic exchange visit at the Government College of Education in Chandigarh. The visit coincided with preparations for the ITEP program.

headline: Coastal Security Drill 'Sea Vigil 2026' Begins in Goa
summary: The coastal security drill 'Sea Vigil 2026' has commenced along the Goa coastline. Security personnel are evaluating response readiness across maritime zones.

headline: Nationwide 'Sea Vigil' Defence Drill Underway
summary: The 'Sea Vigil' exercise is currently underway along India's coastline, including Goa. The drill assesses coastal defense systems and agency coordination.

headline: Goa Police Arrest 24 in Cyber Fraud Operation
summary: Goa Police arrested 24 individuals across 16 states during a crackdown on cyber crime. The operation targeted interstate financial fraud rings.

headline: Former CM Parsekar Rejoins BJP in Goa
summary: Former Goa Chief Minister Laxmikant Parsekar has rejoined the BJP after four years away from the party. He expressed readiness to take on political responsibilities.

headline: Poland Named Country Focus for IFFI 2026 in Goa
summary: Poland will take center stage as the focus country at IFFI 2026 in Goa. The event will showcase Polish cinema to an international audience.

headline: Goa CM Welcomes Bengaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express
summary: The Chief Minister of Goa welcomed the launch of the Bengaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat service. He highlighted the benefits of improved rail connectivity for the state.

headline: Producer Highlights Positive Reviews for Film 'G.O.A.T'
summary: Producer Mogulla Chandrasekhar stated that viewers have responded positively to the film 'G.O.A.T'. He expressed appreciation for the public praise.

headline: Vande Bharat Express Expedites Goa-Bengaluru Travel
summary: The introduction of the Vande Bharat Express has put travel between Goa and Bengaluru on a faster track. The service offers enhanced connectivity for commuters.

headline: Goa Police Conduct 'Vigil 2.0' Cybercrime Crackdown
summary: Goa Police executed operation 'Vigil 2.0', resulting in 24 arrests across 16 states. The operation focused on dismantling complex cyber fraud networks.

headline: Woman Succumbs to Injuries After Mandrem Scooter Crash
summary: A woman has died days after sustaining injuries in a scooter accident in Mandrem. Authorities are looking into the details of the crash.

headline: Mumbai Native Arrested with Narcotics in Goa
summary: Goa Police arrested a Mumbai native after seizing narcotics worth Rs 2.5 lakh. The individual was taken into custody for illegal drug possession.

headline: South Goa Demands Sustainable Roadmap for Mining
summary: With mining activities resuming, stakeholders in South Goa are advocating for a sustainable operational roadmap. Local groups seek environmental safeguards for ongoing mining work.

headline: Goa’s Census Population Enumeration Starts Dec 1
summary: Population enumeration for Census 2027 in Goa will begin on December 1, following self-enumeration from November 16. Officials have outlined the timeline for state data collection.

headline: Protests Erupt After Navy Restricts Temple Access
summary: Protests broke out in Goa after naval authorities restricted public access to a local temple. Residents are demanding that traditional access be restored.

headline: Goa Prepares for Global Visitors Ahead of Film Festival
summary: Goa is making arrangements for the upcoming film festival to position the state as a destination for international cinema. Organizers expect strong global turnout.

headline: Goa-Bengaluru Vande Bharat Train Starts Nov 13
summary: Regular services for the Goa-Bengaluru Vande Bharat Express will commence on November 13. The train offers a direct link between the two regions.

headline: Chief Minister Announces Proposed Rail Link to Mopa Airport
summary: Goa's Chief Minister announced plans to study a rail link connection to Mopa airport. The proposal includes running a dedicated shuttle service.

headline: Catholic Body Demands White Paper on Law and Order
summary: The Catholic Association in Goa has called for a white paper on the state's law and order situation following recent child rape cases. The organization demanded strict measures to improve public safety.

headline: Goa Police Physical Efficiency Test Dates Released
summary: Goa Police has officially announced the test dates for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) 2026. Candidates can check official notices for schedule details.
